responsibility: This file provides out-of-line HOST_WIDE_INT arithmetic helpers that are either needed for old bootstrap compilers or useful as shared utilities throughout GCC. It includes fallback implementations of bit operations and log2 helpers when not inlined by hwint.h, and always provides checked host-wide integer arithmetic such as gcd, overflow-checked multiplication, and least common multiple. Its role is support code for host integer manipulation used by the compiler, rather than target integer RTL or tree arithmetic.
same_name_distinction: Supplies the out-of-line HOST_WIDE_INT helper implementations associated with gcc/hwint.h, including legacy fallback log2/bit-count operations for older bootstrap compilers and always-linked arithmetic utilities such as gcd, checked multiplication, and least common multiple. The header is the main definition site for the types, limits, format macros, and most inline helpers.
